scripts.ai: cd apps/ai-service && DEMO_SEED=1 uv run simbiotix-ai serve
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/instrument-bridge && uv sync && cd ../ai-service && uv sync
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm -w @simbiotix/web run test && npm -w @simbiotix/api run test
